description: Companies whose Bullrun composite risk score crossed into a different band (e.g. Elevated -> Stretched, or Acute -> Stretched) within the last N days, with prior and current score, the move in points, and the input driving the reading. Use for "what got riskier this week", "any risk deteriorations I should know about", or to monitor a watchlist (pass the tickers to get_company_risk afterwards). Band changes, not small score drift, so every row changed a word on the page. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

days.description: Look-back window in days for band changes.

direction.description: Keep only companies whose composite got worse, got better, or both.

stableBasisOnly.description: true (default) = only real movements. false also includes band changes caused purely by a category starting or stopping scoring (coverage changes, flagged basisChanged).
